ruleExplore.bookList:
<js>
var base = baseUrl;
var g = base.match(/gender=(\d+)/) ? base.match(/gender=(\d+)/)[1] : '1';
var pg = base.match(/page=(\d+)/) ? base.match(/page=(\d+)/)[1] : '1';
var ty = base.match(/[?&]type=(\w+)/) ? base.match(/[?&]type=(\w+)/)[1] : 'cat';
var headers = buildHeaders(java);
var data;
if (ty === 'rank') {
  var rt = base.match(/rank_type=([^&]+)/) ? base.match(/rank_type=([^&]+)/)[1] : 'rec_list';
  var ps = { rank_type: rt, category_id: '0', tab_type: g, category_type: '0', read_preference: '4', from: '6', new_user: '1', refresh_state: '4', book_privacy: '1' };
  signParams(ps, java);
  data = JSON.parse(java.ajax('https://api-bc.wtzw.com/api/v1/leader-board?' + urlEncode(ps) + ',{"headers":' + JSON.stringify(headers) + '}'));
  var rbooks = (data && data.data && data.data.books) || [];
  if (rbooks.length) {
    var detUrls = [];
    for (var di = 0; di < rbooks.length; di++) {
      var dp = { id: rbooks[di].id, imei_ip: '2937357107', teeny_mode: 0 };
      signParams(dp, java);
      detUrls.push('https://api-bc.wtzw.com/api/v5/book/detail?' + urlEncode(dp) + ',{"headers":' + JSON.stringify(headers) + '}');
    }
    var ress = java.ajaxAll(detUrls);
    for (var ri = 0; ri < ress.length && ri < rbooks.length; ri++) {
      try {
        var det = JSON.parse(String(ress[ri].body() || ''));
        var bb = det && det.data && det.data.book;
        rbooks[ri].author = (bb && bb.author) || '';
      } catch (e) { rbooks[ri].author = ''; }
    }
  }
} else if (ty === 'tag') {
  var cid = base.match(/category_id=(\d+)/) ? base.match(/category_id=(\d+)/)[1] : '0';
  var tp = { gender: g, need_filters: '1', page: pg, tag_id: cid };
  signParams(tp, java);
  data = JSON.parse(java.ajax('https://api-bc.wtzw.com/api/v4/tag/index?' + urlEncode(tp) + ',{"headers":' + JSON.stringify(headers) + '}'));
} else {
  var cid = base.match(/category_id=(\d+)/) ? base.match(/category_id=(\d+)/)[1] : '0';
  var ps = { gender: g, category_id: cid, need_filters: '1', page: pg, need_category: '0' };
  signParams(ps, java);
  data = JSON.parse(java.ajax('https://api-bc.wtzw.com/api/v4/category/get-list?' + urlEncode(ps) + ',{"headers":' + JSON.stringify(headers) + '}'));
}
JSON.stringify(data);
</js>
